title: How Signature Replay & EIP-712 Typed Data Works
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant S as Off-chain Signer
    participant D as EIP-712 Digest
    participant C as Verifying Contract
    Note over D: domain binds name version chainId contract
    S->>D: hashStruct of message fields
    D-->>S: digest 0x1901 sep hashStruct
    S->>S: sign digest off-chain
    S->>C: submit message plus signature
    C->>C: recompute digest
    C->>C: ecrecover authorized signer
    C->>C: check nonce equals expected
    C->>C: consume nonce then execute

title: Attack Vector: Replaying a Valid Signature
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Signer issues one signature] --> B{"Digest binding complete?"}
    B -->|Yes| Z[Single one-time use]
    B -->|No| ATK[Replay possible]
    subgraph Missing bindings
        V1["V1: no nonce in payload"]
        V2["V2: nonce signed not enforced"]
        V3["V3: chainId frozen or unchecked"]
        V4["V4: wrong or mutable domain"]
        V5["V5: encodePacked collision"]
    end
    ATK --> V1
    ATK --> V2
    ATK --> V3
    ATK --> V4
    ATK --> V5
    V1 --> R["Reuse sig forever, drain funds"]
    V2 --> R
    V3 --> X["Replay on forked or other chain"]
    V4 --> Y["Cross-deployment replay"]
    V5 --> F["Forge params, same digest"]

title: Defense: Bind Every Dimension of the Digest
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Start[Incoming signed action] --> N{"Nonce equals stored expected?"}
    N -->|No| Rej["Revert: stale or replayed"]
    N -->|Yes| CH{"chainId equals block.chainid?"}
    CH -->|No| Rej
    CH -->|Yes| DM{"verifyingContract equals address this?"}
    DM -->|No| Rej
    DM -->|Yes| RC["Recompute separator after fork"]
    RC --> HS["hashStruct commits every field"]
    HS --> CN["Consume nonce before action"]
    CN --> EX["Execute authorized action"]
    subgraph Four binding dimensions
        U["Uniqueness: nonce"]
        C2["Chain: chainId"]
        D2["Domain: contract plus salt"]
        I["Integrity: full struct hash"]
    end
